Markets.title: NSE said to plan allowing trading in its shares on its own platform
Markets.summary: The National Stock Exchange of India (NSE) plans to allow trading of its shares on its own platform after listing on the rival BSE, pending approval from the Securities and Exchange Board of India (Sebi). The IPO is targeted for September and could boost liquidity while paving the way for inclusion in Nifty indexes.

Markets.title: Global Market: China, Hong Kong stocks rebound as healthcare and tech shares rally
Markets.summary: China and Hong Kong stocks rebounded on Thursday following a sharp selloff, driven by rallies in the healthcare and technology sectors. Fresh share buyback announcements and gains in South Korea and Japan also supported the broader Asian market recovery, though investors remained cautious amid high volatility.

Markets.title: Explained: How a JP Morgan unit and a Mumbai-based stock broking firm allegedly manipulated Sensex during CAS
Markets.summary: The market regulator flagged three sharp Sensex spikes, including a 362-point jump in two seconds and a 405-point surge in 28 seconds, during the Closing Auction Session. These abnormal movements occurred as the index's closing price moved from a 3:15 pm reference of 77,829.60 to around 78,080.

Markets.title: Titagarh Rail Systems shares gain 3% after Indian Railways' approval for traction motor supply
Markets.summary: Titagarh Rail Systems shares rose 3% after Indian Railways approved the company to supply up to 1,200 traction motors annually. This vendor approval strengthens the company's position in the railway equipment market.

Markets.title: Coforge shares jump 3% after IT major launches private equity unit
Markets.summary: Coforge shares rose 3% on Thursday following the IT services company's launch of a dedicated Private Equity business unit. The new vertical will use Coforge's AI capabilities and acquisition expertise to help funds drive portfolio optimization and technology-led transformation.

Markets.title: Power Finance Corporation and REC shares fall up to 3% after Morgan Stanley downgrade
Markets.summary: Power Finance Corporation and REC shares dropped up to 3% on Thursday following a Morgan Stanley downgrade to Equal-Weight. The brokerage cited slower loan growth and reduced earnings estimates for fiscal years 2028 and 2029 ahead of their proposed merger.

Geo-Political.title: At least 13 killed in Kyiv as Ukraine grapples with air defence shortages
Geo-Political.summary: At least 13 people were killed in a massive Russian air attack targeting apartment blocks and warehouses in Kyiv on Thursday. The strikes occurred as Ukraine struggles with critical shortages of air defense systems.

Geo-Political.title: Founder of collapsed Chinese property giant Evergrande sentenced to life in prison
Geo-Political.summary: The founder of the collapsed Chinese property giant Evergrande has been sentenced to life in prison. This ruling marks a major development in the aftermath of the company's collapse, which heavily impacted China's real estate sector.

Geo-Political.title: Trump vows tougher economic measures on Iran and supporting countries
Geo-Political.summary: Following the expiration of a 60-day ceasefire without a diplomatic resolution, Donald Trump has promised harsher economic measures against Iran and its allies. This comes as the ongoing conflict shows no signs of a military or political off-ramp.

Geo-Political.title: Mushroom killer must stay in jail forever for 'truly dreadful' crime, appeal court told
Geo-Political.summary: Prosecutors are arguing that Erin Patterson's prison sentence is too short because it includes the possibility of parole. They stated at an appeal court that she must remain in jail forever for her "truly dreadful" mushroom poisoning crimes.

Geo-Political.title: Australia 'outraged' after Israel decides not to open criminal investigation into killing of aid worker in Gaza
Geo-Political.summary: Australia summoned the Israeli ambassador after Israel decided against opening a criminal investigation into the killing of aid worker Zomi Frankcom in Gaza. The Australian foreign minister called the decision insulting and expressed outrage over the lack of accountability.

Geo-Political.title: Missing teen hiker found dead in Australian bush after eight-day search
Geo-Political.summary: Lily Hooper was found dead in the Australian bush following an eight-day search for the missing teen hiker. The state premier initially reported she had been found alive before police confirmed her death.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: The author discovered that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This experiment highlights a shift in organic traffic generation from traditional SEO to AI optimization (AIO).

AI & Tech.summary: This guide highlights the top 10 artificial intelligence tools designed to revolutionize content creation in 2025. These essential technologies help digital creators stay ahead of the curve and streamline their workflows.

AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has transitioned into a generative AI platform that allows users to create digital content. The tool also provides features for creators to share and monetize their AI-generated content.

AI & Tech.summary: This beginner's guide explains how to use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money online. It also highlights top CJ affiliate programs and alternative platforms.

Data & Insights.title: RBI’s $50 billion boost may not be enough to lift the rupee | Here's why
Data & Insights.summary: India expects a $50 billion balance-of-payments surplus in fiscal year 2027, but experts warn it may not strengthen the rupee. This limited impact depends on whether the foreign currency inflows enter the market or are absorbed as reserves by the central bank.

Data & Insights.title: RBI's rate-setting panel hints at future policy tightening if inflation persists
Data & Insights.summary: RBI Governor Malhotra stated that the central bank requires more clarity on persistently high prices before acting. The monetary policy committee hinted at potential policy tightening if inflation remains elevated.

Data & Insights.title: Who pays, who profits — The economics of India's toll highways landscape
Data & Insights.summary: Data from the Indian Highway Management Company Limited reveals that high-traffic routes, changing private sector involvement, and the FASTag annual pass are shaping India's toll highway revenue models. These factors collectively determine how toll revenues are generated and distributed across the country's highway network.

Data & Insights.title: Ind-Ra raises India’s FY27 GDP growth estimate to 6.8%
Data & Insights.summary: India Ratings and Research (Ind-Ra) has raised India’s fiscal year 2027 GDP growth forecast to 6.8%. However, the agency warns that the West Asia war, high inflation, a weakening currency, and sluggish capital expenditure remain key downside risks.

Data & Insights.title: Govt frontloads farm spending as El Nino risks cloud rural outlook
Data & Insights.summary: The Indian government is accelerating agricultural spending and fertilizer subsidies to protect rural incomes. This financial intervention aims to counter the threats posed by El Nino and a weak monsoon to the rural economy.

Data & Insights.title: $57 billion pours in, another $30 billion may follow: Indian economy eyes massive $50 billion surplus
Data & Insights.summary: SBI Research projects a $50 billion balance of payments surplus for India in fiscal year 2027. This financial surplus will be driven by strong foreign currency inflows totaling tens of billions of dollars.

India.title: Tribal Tangle: BJP Bets On 1st-time MP To Tackle A South Rajasthan Challenge
India.summary: First-time MP Manna Lal Rawat, who entered politics in 2024 by winning the Udaipur Lok Sabha seat, has been appointed president of the BJP's ST Morcha. The BJP is relying on him to address political challenges in southern Rajasthan.

India.title: "Extreme Appeasement": Amit Shah Blasts Congress Over Full Vande Mataram Snub
India.summary: Amit Shah criticized Congress for not singing the full Vande Mataram, calling it extreme appeasement. He stated that this decision repeats a historical mistake that contributed to India's partition.

India.title: NCERT Shares Third Language Resources, Books: Here's How To Download
India.summary: NCERT has released third-language textbooks and learning resources on its online portal. Students can download these materials by selecting their specific class and language from the website.

India.title: Telangana Boy Stabbed Principal 27 Times. How His Lavish Lifestyle Busted Him
India.summary: On August 12, Kallu Roopa Reddy was found dead at her residence with 27 stab wounds. A teenage boy from Telangana was arrested for the murder after his newly lavish lifestyle exposed him.

India.title: Tarun Tejpal Challenges Rape Case Conviction Order In Supreme Court
India.summary: Tarun Tejpal has appealed to the Supreme Court to challenge his conviction in a rape case. This follows the Goa government's recent petition to the Supreme Court seeking to increase his sentence to life imprisonment.

India.title: Uttarakhand On Alert As Heavy Rain Swells Rivers Across Garhwal
India.summary: Heavy rainfall in Uttarakhand has caused rivers across the Garhwal region to swell, prompting authorities to issue a high alert. The Commissioner has advised Char Dham pilgrims to stay cautious and follow safety guidelines.

General.title: Prince Harry and Meghan moving back to UK later this month
General.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan are moving back to the UK later this month. Their children, Prince Archie and Princess Lilibet, are enrolled to start school in September.

General.title: Harry and Meghan are experts in surprise - but why are they returning to UK now?
General.summary: Prince Harry and Meghan Markle have unexpectedly decided to return to the UK. This sudden visit raises new questions for both the couple and the rest of the Royal Family.

General.title: Travelodge boss resigns as chain tackles security after sex assault at hotel
General.summary: Travelodge boss Jo Boydell has resigned following criticism over the hotel chain's handling of safety and security issues. The leadership change comes as the company works to address security concerns following a sexual assault at one of its hotels.

General.title: School 'deeply saddened' by death of family in sea off Shoreham
General.summary: Ellen Wilkinson School for Girls in Ealing pays tribute to Sara El-Khawas, 14, and her family who died.

General.title: Giant whales move into Greenland waters as ice disappears
General.summary: Melting sea ice caused by climate change has opened up Greenland waters to giant whales. These marine mammals are now using the newly accessible region for intense feeding.
